faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the YISU Lab Assistant -Bio Laboratory Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit applications for the YISU Lab Assistant -Bio Laboratory Recruitment 2026 is 11th September 2026. Candidates are advised to apply well in advance of the deadline to avoid any last-minute technical issues.

faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Master's or Bachelor's Degree in Biotechnology, Microbiology, Biochemistry, Life Sciences, Biological Sciences, Biomedical Sciences, or any other relevant allied discipline to be eligible for the Lab Assistant -Bio Laboratory position.
